user.title: Heating Intelligence
user.description: Set up read-only heating analysis. Configure rooms and global sensors after setup.

menu_options.room_area: Configure room areas, ACH and window contacts
menu_options.room_air_quality: Configure room temperature and air quality

thermal_topology.title: Room thermal conductances
thermal_topology.description: Enter explicit room-to-outdoors envelope, room-to-room and upstairs-to-attic conductances. Use the calculated W/K values for each room. These are configured physical inputs, not automatically learned values. Configure one room or connection at a time, save, then reopen to add another.

global_settings.title: Global settings
global_settings.description: Configure optional weather-station inputs and heating energy sensors. A weather entity can supply standard outdoor attributes; individual sensors can override or supplement it. Attic temperature and humidity are optional. Heat-flow estimates require explicit U-values and areas; insulation thickness alone is not converted into a U-value.

data.gas_consumption_entity: Heating-only cumulative gas consumption (m³ or kWh)

add_room.title: Add a room
add_room.description: Select the room's floor, thermostat demand relay and temperature sensor. Floor area, measured air changes and window contact are optional.

data.enable_co2: Add a CO2 sensor for this room
data.air_changes_per_hour: Measured room air changes per hour (ACH)

room_air_quality.title: Select room
room_air_quality.description: Choose the room whose temperature, humidity and CO2 sensors you want to configure.

room_air_quality_config.title: Room air quality
room_air_quality_config.description: Configure the temperature sensor, humidity sensor and optional CO2 sensor for {room_name}. Leave the temperature or humidity sensor empty to clear it; disable CO2 to remove its sensor.

data.enable_co2: Configure a CO2 sensor for this room

room_air_quality_co2.title: Select CO2 sensor
room_air_quality_co2.description: Choose the CO2 sensor for this room.

add_room_co2.title: Add room CO2 sensor
add_room_co2.description: Select the CO2 sensor for {room_name}. CO2 is optional and only requested when enabled for this room.

room_area.title: Select room
room_area.description: Choose a room whose floor area, measured air changes or window contact you want to configure.

set_room_area.title: Room area, ventilation and window contact
set_room_area.description: Set floor area, optional measured ACH and window contact, and the UFH screed thickness for {room_name}. Existing rooms default to 4.5 cm until you enter a measured value.

data.air_changes_per_hour: Measured room air changes per hour (ACH)
data.ufh_screed_thickness_cm: UFH screed thickness for this room (cm)

pump_settings.title: Pump settings
pump_settings.description: Select instantaneous power (W) and cumulative energy (kWh) sensors for each manifold pump. Leave both fields empty to omit a pump.

edit_room.title: Select room
edit_room.description: Choose the room whose floor assignment you want to change.

edit_room_floor.title: Change room floor
edit_room_floor.description: Set the floor for {room_name}. The currently saved floor is selected by default.

house_assessment.title: Building and envelope
house_assessment.description: Enter known building details. Your known defaults are prefilled; leave unknown values blank. You can revisit and change every answer. Optional roof and attic-floor U-values and areas enable approximate conductive heat-flow estimates.

data.attic_floor_area_m2: Insulated ceiling area between upstairs and attic (m²)

assessment_heating.title: Heating system and thermal mass
assessment_heating.description: Describe the heat source, distribution and thermal storage. Defaults reflect known system details but can be changed.

data.boiler_dhw: Does the boiler also produce domestic hot water?
data.ac_heating: Are air conditioners used for heating?

assessment_occupancy.title: Ventilation and internal gains
assessment_occupancy.description: These inputs help distinguish building heat loss from ventilation, occupancy and internal heat gains. Unknown answers are fine.

edit_rooms.title: Edit rooms
edit_rooms.description: Choose which room settings you want to edit.

menu_options.room_area: Configure room area, ACH and window contact

edit_room_demand.title: Select room
edit_room_demand.description: Choose the room whose heating-demand entity you want to change.

edit_room_demand_config.title: Room heating demand
edit_room_demand_config.description: Select the heating-demand entity for {room_name}. Leave it empty to remove the room's demand sensor.

envelope_surfaces.title: Envelope surfaces
envelope_surfaces.description: Add, edit or remove measured opaque surfaces. Select the room, physical boundary, measured area and whole-assembly U-value. No U-values or dimensions are inferred.

envelope_surface_details.title: Envelope surface details
envelope_surface_details.description: Enter an explicit measured area and whole-assembly U-value. Use adjacent heated space for a shared boundary with a heated neighbouring dwelling; it is kept separate from outdoor losses.

window_details.title: Window geometry and shading
window_details.description: Record measured geometry. The optional Uw must describe the whole window, not center-of-glass Ug.

floor_finishes.title: UFH floor-finish zones
floor_finishes.description: Add, edit or remove finish layers by room. Multiple zones can belong to one room, for example tile in the bathroom section and parquet in the connected hallway.

floor_finish_details.title: Floor-finish zone properties
floor_finish_details.description: Enter the zone area and finish material properties. Preset values are starting estimates and can be edited.
